core_acceptance_gate.reason: Parent accepted final10core source hashes after full review, source/consumer and native Windows numeric validation.

planned_contract.budget: Input, candidate/chunk/record counts, decoding tokens/references/depth/bytes, template matches, overlaps, retained output, and total report size are bounded; exceeded or unsupported coverage is OPEN, never clean.
candidate_validation: Full image magic only generates candidates; bounded chunk header/data CRC and allocated record walk establish local context.
Record dual size, length, alignment, actual bounds, timestamp and BinXML/substitution grammar validate candidates.
Resident-template parsing derives chunk-coordinate hypothesis from declared relative pointer; absent original context remains UNVERIFIED.
Candidate overlap, duplicate content and truncation are separately reported, without asserting original event identity.
planned_contract.input: Bounded immutable local regular file byte image; no devices, live collection, URLs, stdin or runtime network. No archive decompression/member traversal; raw bytes, including container bytes, are treated only as the physical image. Path reader rejects symlink components and traversal, platform support is gated.
planned_contract.output: Privacy-default bounded JSON provenance and numeric facts; explicit selected-field disclosure. Optional bounded XML reconstruction clearly inferred and correctly XML-escaped, without generic input XML parsing or log rewriting.
removed: lxml XML interpretation and regex XML substitution
Hardcoded EventID slot3 and floating point FILETIME conversions
template_matching: Collect complete typed template AST and all source offsets/GUID/instance identifiers, without XML regex substitution or hardcoded EventID substitution index.
Match every referenced slot and dependency against actual typed substitution constraints; retain distinct ASTs even with equal type signatures.
No match INCOMPLETE; one distinct template RECOVERED_INFERRED; multiple AMBIGUOUS. Unique inference never proves original event identity.
Catalog entries from bad CRC contexts are retained as untrusted; provenance travels with each candidate.

review_notes: Original resident-template heuristic only probes substitution count/types; new implementation must enumerate validated grammar hypotheses.
Original template constraints collapse same type signatures and use XML regex substitution; new directory must retain AST identity and all source origins.
Original orphan records may be skipped via broad exception paths; new output must retain budget/unsupported/truncated diagnostics.

upstream.coverage_statement: All downloaded selected runtime, CLI, package entry, README and full license reviewed. Remaining upstream repository tests/CI/PyInstaller/ignore files and third-party dependency implementations not claimed audited.
